summary: Published a universal signed and notarized DMG from source commit 5e734229. It adds the experimental Ferrite RT-950 Pro link-protocol driver and web profile, completes Ferrite empty-read and zone ranges, preserves driver extras it cannot decode for safe repair, and carries the corrupt Baofeng tone, 5RX S-CODE, refused-channel progress, FT-60, sibling-model, AnyTone USB, XWayland, PMR446, TH-D7G, and UV-5R Mini work. Artifact SHA-256: cca9e2081060d0c389ed40e0c400a696bb7f76b13037929422d733321aa1659f. Apple notarization: 83014a33-40e8-4065-abba-40cf4b8585f6. The live manifest reports macOS 1.0.73.
